simple.meaning: שִׂיד (sîyd) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to plaster.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 27:2. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׂיד (H7874).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שִׂיד (sîyd) / H7874 is traced through Deuteronomy 27:2, Deuteronomy 27:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.
